title: Font Manager pangram file
description: Pangrams for the preview, one per language preset of data/charsets at most. pangrams.json follows it.

code.description: BCP 47 tag of a data/charsets language preset (sr-Cyrl). Unique in the file.

kind.description: pangram: a sentence that uses every letter (or the traditional pangram of the language); sample: a sample sentence, for a language with no true pangram (Chinese, Korean).

text.description: The text, NFC. Every character except white space and common punctuation is in the language preset's base or auxiliary characters.

source.description: Where the text comes from: wikipedia (Wikipedia's list of pangrams) or project (written here from the preset's characters; see README).
